name: Sinaida Krivchenko
tagline: New media artist. Interactive projections & stage visuals. Prague-based, working globally.
bio: Sinaida Krivchenko is a Prague-based new media artist building living visual systems for stage and screen — real-time TouchDesigner and GLSL work, interactive projections, and audio-reactive visuals for live performance. Trained as a biomedical engineer (MSc, Bauman Moscow State Technical University), with prior careers in IT leadership at General Electric and creative direction for cultural institutions in Amsterdam. Works with performing-arts organisations, musicians, festivals, and cultural institutions.
services: Audio-reactive concert visuals — one system per song, listening to the live mix, delivered as a turnkey show or operated live
Interactive web — sites and components that move, react and watch: real-time WebGL and shaders, on-device camera and gesture control, generative sound
Theater and dance scenography — real-time systems that follow the performers' bodies and the sound, developed with the creative team
Installations and generative visual identities for venues, brands and institutions, adapted to the space they run in
